thread:
mia (Docs Engineer): Heads-up: new policy for code samples + example bundles is out. TL;DR: keep docs snippets minimal, move runnable examples to the docs-examples repo, and ship example bundles with SDK releases. Full policy in the PR: https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs-examples/pull/12 :memo:
ryan (DevRel): Nice. Is there a short migration checklist we can put in the release notes? :eyes:
mia (Docs Engineer): yes — checklist is in the PR, copied here: 1) extract runnable examples to /examples/<sdk>/, 2) add README + minimal snippet in docs, 3) tag example bundle with SDK semver, 4) update docs link to point to bundle. Quickest for most teams: script in repo automates step 1-2.
sam (SDK Lead): Does this change how we publish NPM/PyPI packages? I.e., will bundles be separate artifacts?
mia (Docs Engineer): bundles are published as a separate release asset on GitHub and linked from the SDK changelog. We will also add a small package on PyPI/npm for reference helpers (not the full examples) — details in the PR.
tyler (CLI PM): Impact on CLI docs? We currently inline 30–40 line examples a lot.
mia (Docs Engineer): Short inline snippets (1–6 lines) are fine. Anything longer should be a link to runnable example and a small tl;dr snippet. Goal is keep docs small and copy/paste friendly.
ryan (DevRel): Can we add a quick code banner that points to the example bundle? e.g., [Runnable example -> GitHub]. That helped with adoption before.
mia (Docs Engineer): yep, pattern added to the docs template. I'll add the banner component and an automated check that ensures every long code block has a link.
julie (Legal): Quick note: we need to standardize license header in examples (Apache-2.0) and add a CONTRIBUTING.md. Please make sure new examples include license text.
mia (Docs Engineer): good call — PR updated with license checklist.
sam (SDK Lead): timeline? When does this become official?
mia (Docs Engineer): policy effective date: 1959360000 (about 7 days). Migration guidance and linter check go live in docs CI then. Soft enforcement: docs CI will warn for 30 days, then block if unchanged. Deprecation for existing inline example files: 90 days to migrate, 180 days hard remove.
ryan (DevRel): Is there an opt-out for dedicated enterprise customers that want self-hosted examples?
mia (Docs Engineer): enterprise teams can host their own example bundles, but public docs must link to canonical repo. We added an enterprise exceptions process in the PR.
deploy-bot: A docs-policy review request was created by mia and assigned to sam, tyler, julie — https://github.com/redwoodinc/docs-examples/pull/12 :white_check_mark:
tyler (CLI PM): I'll carve out time this week to update CLI docs. Thanks, team. :rocket:
ryan (DevRel): I'll draft an internal announcement for next week's all-hands.
mia (Docs Engineer): thanks — I'll follow up with the template + migration script in the PR comments. If anyone needs help migrating pages, DM me. :slightly_smiling_face:
